notes.title: Rebalancing of the levels
notes.notes:
Through the feedback of some players we noticed that the game mode with the orange lights was disproportionately much more difficult than the other modes.
So there was a rebalancing of the 60 levels in this way, in order to make them easier.
We hope that the difficulty of the game will become more homogeneous.
Sorry for any inconvenience.

We are working to always offer our players the best experience.
Have fun.

notes.title: Chinese-Simplified and Portuguese-Brazil translation
notes.notes:
In view of the large number of Chinese and Brazilian players who purchased our game, we are pleased to announce that the game has been translated into Chinese-Simplified and Portuguese-Brazil.
[b]It is now possible to play On Pixels: A lights out game in Chinese-Simplified or in Portuguese-Brazil[/b]
We wish you all good fun.
